title: Leads
emptyStateDesc: Every time someone saves your contact, taps your NFC card, or submits a form on your public profile, they land here automatically.

contacts.emptyDesc: Contacts are created from every lead captured through your cards, NFC taps, QR codes, and forms.

companies.emptyDesc: Companies appear automatically once your captured leads include a company name.

drawer.addTaskPlaceholder: Add a task for this lead…
drawer.noTasks: No tasks assigned to this lead

notes.heading: Team notes
notes.intro: Notes the team wrote on its leads, newest first. Write one on a lead, and name a teammate with @ to tell them.

empty.all: No notes yet. Open a lead and write one in its Activity tab.
empty.mine: You haven't written any notes yet.

notes.placeholder: Write a note… Type @ to mention a teammate
notes.confirmDelete: Delete this note? This can't be undone.

local.title: Saved in this browser only
local.body: These were written in the old Notes tab, which kept them on this device where your team couldn't see them. Copy what you need onto the lead it belongs to, then delete it here.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Follow-ups and reminders, on their own or tied to a lead.
tasks.emptyDesc: Try clearing search text or check your active tab.
tasks.descPlaceholder: e.g. Call client to verify invoice template

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: What happened across your leads, newest first.
activity.noMatchDesc: Try changing your activity filter or engage with your contacts.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Funnel, growth and sources, from your pipeline.

meeting.title: Meeting request
meeting.acceptPlaceholder: e.g. See you at our office, second floor.
meeting.declinePlaceholder: e.g. I'm travelling that day. Any time next week works.
meeting.noEmailHint: No email on this lead, so nothing is sent. You can tell them on WhatsApp after.
meeting.acceptedEmailed: Accepted. A confirmation and calendar invite went to {{email}}.
meeting.acceptedNoEmail: Accepted. This lead left no email, so let them know yourself.
meeting.declinedEmailed: Declined. {{email}} got a note with a link to choose another time.
meeting.declinedNoEmail: Declined. This lead left no email, so let them know yourself.
meeting.waAccepted: Hi {{name}}, your meeting on {{when}} is confirmed. See you then.
meeting.waDeclined: Hi {{name}}, I can't make {{when}}. Could you pick another time from my card?

errors.taken: Someone else asked for this time since you declined it.
errors.generic: That didn't go through. Try again.

export.all: Download every lead as a CSV for Excel
export.filtered: Download the {{count}} leads shown as a CSV for Excel

import.buttonHint: Bring leads in from Excel or CSV
import.title: Import leads
import.subtitle: From Excel or a CSV file, such as an export from another CRM or a list from an event.
import.pick: Choose an Excel or CSV file
import.pickHint: Or drop it here · up to {{max}} rows

columns.who: A header row, and for each lead a name, an email or a phone number.
columns.others: Optional: company, job title, stage, temperature, value, owner (a teammate's email), date added, notes. Column names can be in English or Arabic, in any order.
columns.export: A file exported from this page imports as it is.

import.tooMany: Only the first {{max}} rows are taken. Split the file to import the rest.

duplicates.title: Leads already here (same email or phone)
duplicates.fillHint: Empty fields are filled from the file, and its notes are added. Nothing they already have changes.

notices.unknownOwner: Owner isn't a member here: assigned to you
notices.unknownStage: Stage isn't in your pipeline: put in the first stage
notices.badField: A value didn't fit its field and was left out

done.title: Import finished
done.next: Imported leads are marked “Imported” as their source, so you can filter them.

errors.type: Choose an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file.
errors.read: That file can't be read. Save it again as .xlsx or CSV and try again.
errors.noColumns: No column for a name, email or phone was found. Check the file's first row.
errors.empty: The file has no rows under its header.
errors.send: The file couldn't be checked. Try again.
errors.partway: The import stopped partway ({{reason}}). Rows already imported are kept; importing again skips them.

add.title: Add a lead
add.subtitleScan: Photograph their business card, or type the details in.
add.scanHint: Take a photo of a paper card and the details fill themselves in. It reads the card's QR code too.

errors.notCard: No business card found in that photo. Try again with the card filling the frame.
errors.tooMany: Too many cards read in the last hour. Type this one in, or try again later.
errors.read: The card couldn't be read right now. Type the details in instead.
errors.empty: Add at least a name, an email or a phone number.
errors.save: The lead wasn't saved. Try again.

add.preparing: Getting ready to read (first time only)…

readBy.qr: Read from the card's QR code, exactly as its owner saved it.
readBy.ai: Read by AI. Check the details before saving; the photo isn't kept.
readBy.device: Read on this phone; the photo never left it. Check the name, title and company before saving.
readBy.deviceArabic: Read on this phone; the photo never left it. Arabic is harder to read this way: check every field, the phone number above all, before saving.

waiting.banner: Nobody has reached out yet · waiting {{span}}

compose.title: Message
compose.noPhone: This lead has no phone number that WhatsApp can use.
compose.noEmail: This lead has no email address.
compose.subject: Subject
compose.hint: Edit it as you like. It opens ready to send, and is saved to this lead's activity.
compose.logFailed: The message opened, but it couldn't be saved to the lead.
compose.manageHint: The messages your team sends leads. Fields such as the lead's first name are filled in for each lead when a message is opened.
compose.name: Name

meet.title: Met someone
meet.qrHint: Let them scan this with their phone camera. Your card opens, and they can save you or send you their details.
meet.noCard: You don't have a published card yet. Make one, and it shows here as a QR code to scan.
meet.greeting: Nice to meet you! Here's my card, so you have my details: {{url}}
meet.sendNow: Send them your card now, while you're still together.
meet.savedNoContact: Add a phone number or email later to follow up.
meet.waiting: No signal: saved on this phone, and added to your leads as soon as you're back online.

duplicates.title: Possible duplicates
duplicates.subtitle: Leads with the same email or phone number are usually one person entered twice.
duplicates.how: The kept lead's empty details are filled from the others, and their history and tasks move to it. Other emails and numbers are noted on it. The rest are deleted.
duplicates.hint: Looks like the same person as {{names}}.

mentions.none: No teammate who can see this lead matches.

fields.title: Fields
fields.emptyDrawer: Add your own fields to every lead, like Budget, City or Industry.
fields.manageSubtitle: Your own fields on every lead: what your team needs to know that the standard ones don't cover.
fields.emptyManager: No fields yet. Add the first one below.
fields.label: Name
fields.optionsHint: One per line, or separated by commas.
fields.confirmDelete: Delete the field “{{label}}”? Its value is removed from every lead.
fields.full: A workspace can have up to {{max}} fields.

invalid.URL: Enter a web address, like nile.com.

feed.failed: The activity could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
